title.narrative: School bag provision project in South Sudan

description.narrative: Distribution of 15,000 school bags equipped with supplies

The project aims to support and strengthen the education sector in South Sudan, especially for the weakest and most needy groups of students, male and female, in order to achieve the goals aimed at eradicating illiteracy, especially among girls. The project also aims to encourage and support students with special needs, in addition to supporting displaced students who were forced by security conditions and unrest. To flee from their original areas.

The school bag provision project in South Sudan secures, prepares, provides, and distributes school bags and supplies for all the school needs of male and female students in primary and secondary schools. The bag contains (notebooks, pens, pencils, ruler, sharpener, erasers, and geometry box). Among other supplies. The bags and supplies will be distributed in each of (Central Equatoria State, Juba Province - and Terekeka Province - in addition to Upper Nile State, Malakal Province - in addition to Western Bahr el Ghazal State, Wau Province).
